COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CLR No.186 of 2023
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. M.C. Pant, Advocate, for the revisionist.
It’s defendant’s revision preferred under 
section 25 of the Provincial Small Causes Courts 
Act, challenging the ex parte judgment of 
17.11.2023, as it was rendered in SCC Suit No.26
of 2023, “Mukesh Kumar Gupta Vs. Rakesh 
Kumar”.
Admit the revision.
Summon the lower court record. 
Issue notice to the respondent. Steps to be 
taken within a week.
Subject to the condition that the appellant 
deposits the entire decreetal amount within a period 
of six weeks from today, and ensures to continue to 
remit the rent by 10th of each month during the 
pendency of this revision, the execution of the 
impugned award dated 17.11.2023, would be kept 
in abeyance. 
It’s goes without saying that violation of any 
of the conditions given thereto would automatically
result into vacation of the stay order.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 18.12.2023
